args.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide AS bid,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(term_start)) AS INTEGER) AS start_year
  FROM legislators_terms
  GROUP BY id_bioguide
  HAVING MIN(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
),
k(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM k WHERE n < 20),
checks AS (
  SELECT c.bid, k.n AS period,
         printf('%04d-12-31', c.start_year + k.n) AS check_date
  FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN k
),
ret AS (
  SELECT ch.period, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.bid) AS retained
  FROM checks ch
  WHERE EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t
     WHERE t.id_bioguide = ch.bid
       AND t.term_start <= ch.check_date
       AND t.term_end >= ch.check_date
  )
  GROUP BY ch.period
),
tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cohort)
SELECT k.n AS period,
       ROUND(1.0 * COALESCE(r.retained, 0) / (SELECT n FROM tot), 4) AS retention_rate
FROM k LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.period = k.n
ORDER BY k.n

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 1917 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019), f AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING min(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'), snapshots AS (SELECT f.*,printf('%04d-12-31',y) dt FROM f JOIN years ON y>=cast(substr(first,1,4) as int)), active AS (SELECT s.*,cast(substr(dt,1,4) as int)-cast(substr(first,1,4) as int) calendar,cast((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365.25 as int) floor36525,cast(round((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365.25) as int) round36525,cast(round((julianday(dt)-julianday(first))/365) as int) round365 FROM snapshots s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=s.id_bioguide AND dt BETWEEN term_start AND term_end)), modes AS (SELECT 'calendar' mode,calendar p,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'floor36525',floor36525,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'round36525',round36525,* FROM active UNION ALL SELECT 'round365',round365,* FROM active) SELECT mode,p,count(distinct id_bioguide) uncensored,count(distinct CASE WHEN dt<='1999-12-31' THEN id_bioguide END) censored FROM modes WHERE p BETWEEN 0 AND 20 GROUP BY mode,p ORDER BY mode,p

WITH RECURSIVE p(n) AS (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM p WHERE n<20),f AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING min(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'),c AS (SELECT f.*,n,cast(substr(first,1,4) as int)+n y FROM f CROSS JOIN p) SELECT n,count(*) denominator,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND y BETWEEN cast(substr(term_start,1,4) as int) AND cast(substr(term_end,1,4) as int))) any_service_in_year,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND date(c.first,'+'||n||' years') BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end)) anniversary,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND date(t.term_start,'start of year')<=printf('%04d-12-31',y) AND printf('%04d-12-31',y)<=date(t.term_end,'start of year','+1 year','-1 day'))) annual_expanded FROM c GROUP BY n ORDER BY n

WITH RECURSIVE p(n) AS(SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM p WHERE n<20),f AS(SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first,max(term_end) last FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide HAVING min(term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'),c AS(SELECT f.*,n,printf('%04d-12-31',cast(substr(first,1,4) as int)+n) dt FROM f CROSS JOIN p) SELECT n,sum(dt<=last) bridged_until_last,sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=c.id_bioguide AND substr(dt,1,4)||'-12-01' BETWEEN term_start AND term_end)) december_first FROM c GROUP BY n ORDER BY n

WITH f AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_start) first FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide), n AS (SELECT id_bioguide,min(term_number) first_no FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide) SELECT count(distinct CASE WHEN f.first BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31' THEN f.id_bioguide END) true_first,count(distinct CASE WHEN t.term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31' THEN f.id_bioguide END) numbered_first,sum(f.first!=t.term_start) changed_first FROM f JOIN n USING(id_bioguide) JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide=n.id_bioguide AND t.term_number=n.first_no
